Duskfade – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Duskfade arrives August 13, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/duskfade-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

Jump, swing, and slash through this 3D action platformer! Can you shatter the shackles of time and save your sister?
